limits: The proxy contract catalog is a conservative superset of possible shell calls, not a claim that every allowed route executes in Hub mode. Never routes are excluded. Do not widen authorization from this catalog.

first_release_verified_* means the earliest local release tag whose committed contract snapshot contains the entry; it is not proof of first actual UI transmission. Entries predating contract files cannot be dated exactly from these snapshots. Null means absent from available released snapshots.

API literal evidence also includes local-only sites; runtime cloud gating must be checked at each caller. Dynamic routes and bare Hub-origin account APIs are not fully represented by this regex index.
No exhaustive interactive runtime sweep was run for this inventory; existing Inbox census and #14690 browser evidence cover named folders only.
